reels.yt_title: You don't need a gym. You need 5 minutes. #Shorts
reels.caption:
You don't need a gym. You need 5 minutes. 🪢

Same goal, two plans. One jumps rope 5 minutes a day. One pays for a gym. Day 30, he trips again. Next day, he jumps again. A year later: 500 jumps in a row vs $600 paid for 3 visits.

Listen to the rhythm change.

Send this to someone who pays for a gym.

#fitness #jumprope #discipline #habits #motivation

reels.title: M37 BASKETBOL (IG tekrar)
reels.caption:
Every swish started as a miss. 🏀

Same ball, two plans. One shoots 100 shots a day. One watches highlights. Day 30: 0 for 10. Next day, he shoots again. A year later: 90% accuracy vs 912 clips watched.

Listen to the sound change. Clank… clank… swish.

Send this to someone who only watches.

#basketball #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
